name: IMEIDB TAC/IMEI device lookup API (imeidb.xyz)
tier_rationale: Operator identity, data handling and track record not reviewed (P319 cond 4: imeidb.xyz must be recorded as community tier - operator, terms, track record - before the online part runs; until then it is unknown tier and receives nothing).

reliability.justification: Commercial TAC database of an unreviewed operator; the model returned for a TAC probe is not independently verified.

error_markers.reason: IMEIDB: 'invalid credentials' inside an HTTP 200 body - could not verify (check the imeidb token)
IMEIDB: account balance exhausted (402) - could not verify

imeidb.description: IMEIDB API token of the team account (TAC -> device model lookup; sent only in the X-Api-Key header)
imeidb.plan_hint: business = a paid IMEIDB plan whose terms legal confirmed for company use (the terms forbid automated access and commercial exploitation without written permission), recorded with `v3lum keys set imeidb --plan business`

tac.title: imeidb.xyz /api/imei/<TAC+000000+Luhn>?format=json (device model of the 8-digit TAC; token in the X-Api-Key header)

terms.quote: You can also transfer a token through the X-Api-Key header. [API docs https://imeidb.xyz/api, 2026-11-26]; the terms forbid using 'any robot, spider or other automatic device ... to access ... the Service' and commercial exploitation without written permission: business use depends on the team's plan and a written decision (key_plans).

tac.notes: Batch p3-G12-1 (P319 imei_check). Only the 8-digit TAC leaves the machine: the API receives TAC + 000000 + the recomputed Luhn digit, never the real serial. Live 2026-11-26: a keyless call with the docs example TAC probe answered HTTP 401 {'success': false, 'message': 'Your request was made with invalid credentials.', 'code': 401} (1.44 s). Documented errors: 401 credentials, 402 out of money, 429 rate limit, 460 invalid IMEI. tacdb.osmocom.org is dead and not used. No success capture with the team's token exists yet (P319 cond 5).

notes: Owned by batch p3-G12-1 (P319). Unknown tier: the policy gate never sends it a PERSONAL_TYPES value (the IMEI type), so the module receives nothing until a reviewer records the community tier.
